## 1. Collect and standardize
Creates five fictional listings and converts them into the same set of fields. The demo makes no network requests.

## 2. Apply fixed matching rules
Uses visible terms and a fixed threshold. Every result records the reasons behind its score.

## 3. Identify duplicates
Compares matching listings with one fictional existing record. Previously seen jobs are classified instead of recreated.

## 4. Preview verified records
Shows which new records a live workflow would save and read back. No database is contacted in this public demo.

## 5. Preview the Slack summary
Builds the same kind of concise result message used by the deployed workflow, but does not send it.
